pages.text: The board has 64 squares, light and dark, in 8 rows and 8 columns. A column is called a file. The files are named with the letters a to h, from White's left to White's right. A row is called a rank. The ranks are numbered 1 to 8, starting from White's side.
Every square has a name: its file letter, then its rank number. This rook stands on e4, where file e meets rank 4. The marked squares are where it can move.
At the start, White's pieces fill ranks 1 and 2, and Black's fill ranks 7 and 8. The board is turned so that each player has a light square in the corner on their right.
A move is named by where a piece starts and where it lands. Here the pawn moves from e2 to e4.

puzzles.hint: The rook is on rank 5 already. Count along the files: a, b, c, d, e.
The rook is on file c already. Rank 8 is the top row.
File h is the last column on the right. Find where it meets rank 3.
Rank 1 is the bottom row, nearest to you.
